summary: Klein 9B model wiring: the 9B transformer + ModelDef, its own turbo LoRA (4B dims do not transfer), and benched steps/cfg for turbo on/off. Graph plumbing (Input_is_Turbo node 52) already exists; licence gate already keyed to klein-9b.

Corrected by the close-out claim audit: 4B's klein-lora-turbo was measured and REJECTED (distilled cfg1/4steps beat base+turbo, 2026-07-27), so 9B must bench turbo before wiring it rather than assume it.

WEIGHT DECIDED by MPI-600 (2026-08-22): ship flux-2-klein-9b-int8-convrot.safetensors + CLIP qwen_3_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors (type flux2), VAE flux2-vae, 4 steps / cfg 1.0. ONE checkpoint. Verdict + numbers: tasks/MPI-600/research/verdict.md. Brief section added.

THIS CARD'S TITLE IS NOW WRONG IN TWO OF THREE PARTS. There is no turbo LoRA (klein_9B_Turbo_r128 rejected and DELETED - the base arm it rides is 6-7x slower than distilled and scores 0/3 on reference placement; strengths 0.7 and 0.35 are worse than 1.0) and no turboToggle (nothing left to switch between). KV also rejected and deleted: 1.27-1.46x end to end, needs a second 9.4GB weight to stay correct, +600-800 MiB on a card with ~340 MiB headroom. This card is now 'wire one 9B checkpoint' - materially smaller.

STILL OWED by this card, from MPI-600: (1) a BRAND-NEW dep for qwen_3_8b_int8_convrot ~9.4GB - qwen3-4b-clip is a different parameter count and boogu-qwen3vl-8b-clip is a VL model at type boogu, neither can be promoted; (2) a thin-headroom user note (~500-800 MiB spare on 16GB); (3) reference placement is ~2/3 at best on every 9B weight and fails SILENTLY; (4) the 4B-LoRA trap in the SHIPPED klein_t2i.json - node 38 unconditional, node 259 on the wf5 branch, both 4B, both loaded even at strength 0; (5) node 52 left true at cfg > 1 blows the image out and reads as a bad model.
